name: Bambuterol

sources.citation: AEMPS. Bambec 10 mg tablets, Spanish product information, June 2018. Archived/canceled medicine (MEDICAMENTO ANULADO); historical safety reference, not proof of present authorization. Accessed November 25, 2026.
Nyberg L, et al. Pharmacokinetics of bambuterol in healthy subjects. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 1998. PMID 9643620.

draft_notes: Foreign reference labeling is explicitly attributed; current Philippine insert and individual clinical assessment remain necessary. No dialysis schedule is inferred.

revision_log.change: Added source-verified descriptive overview, safety and evidence with product-scope limitations.
revision_log.approved_by: W. G. M. Rivero, MD (delegated source-verification workflow; executed by Codex, 2026-11-25)

overview.mechanism: Converted to terbutaline; a healthy-volunteer study documented prolonged generation of the active metabolite after oral administration [[BAMBPK]].
uses: Historical Spanish labeling described maintenance bronchodilator use; this archived reference does not establish current preferred asthma therapy or Philippine approval [[BAMBSP]].

contraindications: Archived Spanish reference: hypersensitivity to the active substance or excipients [[BAMBSP]].

serious: Beta-agonist effects include hypokalemia, arrhythmia and myocardial ischemia [[BAMBSP]].

monitoring: Archived label: monitor potassium in higher-risk settings and glucose in diabetes; do not initiate or increase treatment during an acute asthma exacerbation [[BAMBSP]].

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Succinylcholine and related cholinesterase-metabolized muscle relaxants
key_interactions.effect: Bambuterol can prolong muscle relaxation through plasma cholinesterase inhibition [[BAMBSP]].
key_interactions.action: Inform the anesthesia team before procedures [[BAMBSP]].

renal: Archived Spanish labeling calls for reduced starting treatment at GFR ≤50 mL/min. This historical instruction is not an independently verified local regimen or dialysis schedule [[BAMBSP]].

rows.design: Intravenous and oral administration with plasma/urinary measurements.
rows.findings: Oral absorption and active-metabolite generation prolonged terbutaline exposure.
rows.limitations: Healthy participants; does not establish efficacy in advanced CKD or dialysis.

rows.findings: Continued anti-inflammatory treatment and reassessment during worsening asthma are emphasized.
rows.limitations: Historical safety reference only; current local prescribing instructions require verification.
